title: Extraction of a loose primary molar

transcript.speaker: PARENT
transcript.text: It's been wiggly for weeks and the big tooth is coming in behind it.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Yes, letter S is very loose and the permanent premolar is erupting.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Topical only, removing S. Extraction of S is done, there's the whole root.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Bite on the gauze for fifteen minutes.
